description: Read the store's rules as machine-readable JSON before you spend. Use it to learn refund and dispute terms, mandate and registration caps, supplier trust and the quote lifetime. Returns every policy (mandate, refund, dispute, supplier trust, registration), the store terms and the product and agent JSON Schemas. Read-only and free; it takes only agent_id and principal_id (no agent_key) and nothing is charged.

agent_key.description: Secret returned by register_agent (or X-Agent-Key header)

principal_id.description: The principal you act for (or X-Principal-Id header)

name: get_policies
title: Read store policies
